publicAccess.description: The level of anonymous read access to the container. Defaults to 'None'.

metadata.description: Name/value pairs to associate with the container

defaultEncryptionScope.description: The encryption scope applied by default to blobs in the container. Can only be set when the container is created.

preventEncryptionScopeOverride.description: Whether blobs in the container are prevented from overriding the default encryption scope. Can only be set when the container is created.

lastModified.description: When the container was last modified

hasImmutabilityPolicy.description: Whether the container has an immutability policy

hasLegalHold.description: Whether the container has a legal hold

content.description: The blob content, as a UTF-8 string. Mutually exclusive with 'contentBase64' and 'sourceUri'.

contentBase64.description: The blob content, base64-encoded. Use with Bicep's loadFileAsBase64() to upload a local file. Mutually exclusive with 'content' and 'sourceUri'.

sourceUri.description: A URL to copy the blob content from. The source must be publicly readable or include a SAS token. Mutually exclusive with 'content' and 'contentBase64'.

sizeInMb.description: The size of a page blob in MiB. Required for 'Page' blobs, and ignored otherwise.

encryptionScope.description: The encryption scope to encrypt the blob with

metadata.description: Name/value pairs to associate with the blob

tags.description: Blob index tags, used to categorize and find blobs

lastModified.description: When the blob was last modified

versionId.description: The blob version ID, when versioning is enabled on the account

name.description: The blob name, which may include '/' separators

scope.description: Whether the entry applies to the item itself ('Access') or is inherited by new child items ('Default'). Defaults to 'Access'.

type.description: The type of principal the entry applies to

id.description: The Microsoft Entra object ID of the user or group. Omit to target the owning user or group, and leave unset for 'Mask' and 'Other' entries.

permissions.description: The permissions granted, as a 3-character rwx string such as 'r-x'

metadata.description: Name/value pairs to associate with the file system

accessControl.description: Access control entries applied to the file system root. Requires a hierarchical namespace-enabled account.

owner.description: The Microsoft Entra object ID of the owning user of the file system root

group.description: The Microsoft Entra object ID of the owning group of the file system root

defaultEncryptionScope.description: The encryption scope applied by default to paths in the file system. Can only be set when the file system is created.

lastModified.description: When the file system was last modified

metadata.description: Name/value pairs to associate with the directory

accessControl.description: Access control entries applied to the directory. Requires a hierarchical namespace-enabled account.

permissions.description: POSIX permissions for the directory, as an octal string such as '0750'. Mutually exclusive with 'accessControl'.

owner.description: The Microsoft Entra object ID of the owning user of the directory

group.description: The Microsoft Entra object ID of the owning group of the directory

lastModified.description: When the directory was last modified

path.description: The directory path within the file system

quota.description: The maximum size of the share, in GiB

accessTier.description: The access tier of the share

enabledProtocol.description: The protocol to enable on the share. Defaults to 'Smb', and can only be set when the share is created.

metadata.description: Name/value pairs to associate with the share

lastModified.description: When the share was last modified

metadata.description: Name/value pairs to associate with the directory

lastModified.description: When the directory was last modified

path.description: The directory path within the share. Parent directories must already exist.

content.description: The file content, as a UTF-8 string. Mutually exclusive with 'contentBase64'.

contentBase64.description: The file content, base64-encoded. Use with Bicep's loadFileAsBase64() to upload a local file. Mutually exclusive with 'content'.

metadata.description: Name/value pairs to associate with the file

lastModified.description: When the file was last modified

path.description: The file path within the share. Parent directories must already exist.

metadata.description: Name/value pairs to associate with the queue

approximateMessagesCount.description: The approximate number of messages in the queue

id.description: The signed identifier of the policy

permissions.description: The permissions granted by the policy, as a combination of 'r' (query), 'a' (add), 'u' (update) and 'd' (delete)

start.description: When the policy becomes valid, as an ISO 8601 timestamp

expiry.description: When the policy expires, as an ISO 8601 timestamp

accessPolicies.description: Stored access policies for the table. Managing these requires 'accountKey' authentication, because the table ACL API does not accept Microsoft Entra tokens.

entity.description: The entity properties. Values are written as 'Edm.String' unless overridden in 'entityTypes'.

entityTypes.description: Overrides the EDM type used for individual entity properties. Values in 'entity' are parsed according to the type named here.

timestamp.description: When the entity was last modified

endpointSuffix.description: The storage endpoint suffix. Defaults to 'core.windows.net'.

blobEndpoint.description: The blob service endpoint. Defaults to 'https://<accountName>.blob.<endpointSuffix>'. Set this to target an emulator or a custom domain.

fileEndpoint.description: The file service endpoint. Defaults to 'https://<accountName>.file.<endpointSuffix>'.

queueEndpoint.description: The queue service endpoint. Defaults to 'https://<accountName>.queue.<endpointSuffix>'.

tableEndpoint.description: The table service endpoint. Defaults to 'https://<accountName>.table.<endpointSuffix>'.

dfsEndpoint.description: The Data Lake Storage Gen2 (DFS) endpoint. Defaults to 'https://<accountName>.dfs.<endpointSuffix>'.

accountKey.description: A storage account shared key. Required for operations that do not support Microsoft Entra authentication, such as table stored access policies.

sasToken.description: A shared access signature token, with or without a leading '?'.

accessToken.description: A Microsoft Entra access token for 'https://storage.azure.com'.

useDefaultAzureCredential.description: Whether to authenticate with DefaultAzureCredential (environment, workload identity, managed identity, Azure CLI, ...). Defaults to true when no other credential is supplied.
